notes: Single utterances the embedding-only comparison got wrong, or nearly, on gap_detection_v1.
Each is checked on its own against one template: what the embedding alone hears, how triage
files it, and what the verifier makes of it.
must: items the utterance discusses and that must be heard. must_not: items it must not be
heard as; "*" means every item of the template. An item in neither list is not graded -- an
utterance can reasonably touch a second item, and a probe that penalised that would grade
the labeler's strictness rather than the pipeline.
Three texts are lines of gap_detection_v1, deliberately: these are the utterances that
decided its false positives. One is a paraphrase with no noun for its item, and one is the
closing line of a meeting, which settles nothing. Authored, like the dataset; no real
meeting content. Template examples must not copy any of them (test_semantic).

probes.text: 인덱스 재색인이 먼저 끝나야 정렬 로직을 붙일 수 있습니다
probes.why: Settles a dependency with a verb and no noun. The embedding puts it nearer next_step, under the floor.

probes.text: 인기순 정렬 대신 실시간 개인화로 가는 거죠
probes.why: A direction, not a cold-start plan. The embedding hears cold_start over the floor and loses a real gap.

probes.text: 네. 정렬 로직은 이건우님이 맡고 다음 주 금요일까지 초안을 봅니다
probes.why: Owner and date, no noun naming either.

probes.text: 이건 맡아주시고 다음 주까지 공유 부탁드려요
probes.why: The same shape with no name at all.
Shares its ending with ownership examples; settles nothing.
